t: MCP for Work is a workspace where a person and their own agent do the same job on the same page.
It is live at mcpforwork dot com, open source, and it needs no login.
Building a dashboard over your work mail is a data problem, not a rendering problem.
The hard part is reading the threads and computing the totals, and your ChatGPT already does that.
So this page ships no model and no mailbox integration.
It ships thirty four tools, a policy engine and a renderer, registered through document dot modelContext.
The tools accept counts, sums, top lists and chart points. They never accept rows.
That is a property of the protocol, not a promise.
Every input is validated by zod at the boundary, with hard caps on size and on rate.
Read tools carry readOnlyHint. Anything echoing a human's own words carries untrustedContentHint.
The thirty four tools sit in seven packs, and every pack has a switch on the page.
On the twenty eighth of August, this ran for real inside ChatGPT desktop.
One prompt, and GPT five point six read fifty Gmail threads through its own connector.
It split the classification across two sub agents, and a third checked the counts before anything was written.
Then it stopped and asked whether it could send the de-identified counts and dates to the page.
Nothing else left the mailbox. Six dashboards and an overview were built through the site tools.
Then the part that decides whether any of this is safe.
Asked to approve every payment, the page held both.
One was over the five thousand euro threshold. The other was a pay action, and pay always needs a human.
Approved drafts, zero.
That refusal is not advice a model may ignore. It is a function that returns false.
The human writes the rule, and every call lands in the audit rail.
Then invite somebody. One encrypted link puts two browsers on one live board.
Two people, two agents, one shared trail, and requests running in four directions between them.
Underneath: six hundred and eighty four tests across fifty eight files, all green, MIT licensed and public.
Press share, and the whole board travels in a URL fragment with no server behind it.
MCP for Work. Bring your own agent, and keep the veto.
